title: How a C# program works — quick overview
rememberThis: C# compiles to IL for the CLR; TypeScript erases types into JavaScript.
Tiered JIT optimizes hot methods after warm-up; R2R and Native AOT trade flexibility for cold start.
Pin TFM (net10.0 → C# 14), not LangVersion=latest — use global.json for SDK reproducibility.
File-based apps use #: directives; PublishAot default on publish, ReadyToRun as middle ground.
bullets: Roslyn emits IL + metadata; JIT tiers from quick to optimized — benchmark after warm-up.
using shortens names only; ProjectReference/PackageReference load assemblies.
One entry point per exe — top-level statements synthesize Main.
Convert file-based apps to csproj when CI, tests, or multi-file structure is needed.
